disclaimer: This is a reflection, not a diagnosis. It is a short self-report scale and a reading of your own words, and it can be wrong.

items.E1: Am the life of the party.
items.E7: Talk to a lot of different people at parties.
items.E8: Don't like to draw attention to myself.
items.E9: Don't mind being the center of attention.
items.A5: Am not interested in other people's problems.
items.A7: Am not really interested in others.
items.C6: Often forget to put things back in their proper place.
items.N2: Am relaxed most of the time.
items.O4: Am not interested in abstract ideas.
items.O6: Do not have a good imagination.

reef.name: Reef
reef.tagline: Bright, curious and always in company.

deep.name: Deep
deep.tagline: Curious minds that go far out on their own.

shore.name: Shore
shore.tagline: Sociable and grounded, where water meets land.

lagoon.name: Lagoon
lagoon.tagline: Calm and sheltered, happy with what you know.

clownfish.name: Clownfish
clownfish.blurb: Bright, driven and tender. You plan, you reach out, and you feel it all deeply.

dolphin.name: Dolphin
dolphin.blurb: Playful and organized, and kind with it. You bring people along and stay calm doing it.

barracuda.name: Barracuda
barracuda.blurb: Fast, focused and blunt. You chase what you want, and it runs hot when things get in the way.

orca.name: Orca
orca.blurb: Calm and driven. You say it straight and keep the whole pod moving.

angelfish.name: Angelfish
angelfish.blurb: Colourful and warm, and a little all over the place. Your feelings show, and people love you for it.

otter.name: Otter
otter.blurb: Easygoing, friendly and quick to play. You go with the current and make it fun for everyone.

triggerfish.name: Triggerfish
triggerfish.blurb: Spontaneous, direct and spirited. You react fast and say what you think.

marlin.name: Marlin
marlin.blurb: Free, bold and sure of your own line. Easy about it, and hard to pin down.

seahorse.name: Seahorse
seahorse.blurb: Careful, gentle and thoughtful. You prepare, you notice a lot, and you feel it before others do.

whale.name: Whale
whale.blurb: A gentle giant. Calm, caring and organized, you think big and carry others along quietly.

moray.name: Moray
moray.blurb: Watchful and exact. You keep your own space and notice everything that moves near it.

nautilus.name: Nautilus
nautilus.blurb: Methodical and self-contained. You build your world one careful chamber at a time.

jellyfish.name: Jellyfish
jellyfish.blurb: Dreamy and soft. You drift, you glow, and you pick up on every current around you.

ray.name: Ray
ray.blurb: A gliding, kind daydreamer. You move slowly and calmly and let your mind wander.

anglerfish.name: Anglerfish
anglerfish.blurb: A lone light in the dark. Original, private and wary, you shine on your own terms.

octopus.name: Octopus
octopus.blurb: Clever, independent and improvising. You solve things sideways and need no one's map.

sandpiper.name: Sandpiper
sandpiper.blurb: Quick, busy and careful. You like a routine and good company, and a small wave still makes you jump.

lighthouse.name: Lighthouse
lighthouse.blurb: Steady and warm. You are the one people look for, and you stay put when the weather turns.

pufferfish.name: Pufferfish
pufferfish.blurb: Tidy, sociable and quick to puff up. Standards matter to you, and so does being heard.

anchor.name: Anchor
anchor.blurb: Dependable and firm. You hold the line, say what you mean, and nothing moves you easily.

starfish.name: Starfish
starfish.blurb: Open-hearted and loose. You reach out to everyone, and you feel it when they reach back less.

seal.name: Seal
seal.blurb: Friendly and playful. You love a crowd, a nap and a good time, in no particular order.

crab.name: Crab
crab.blurb: Lively, sideways and a bit pinchy. You enjoy people and defend your shell fast.

gull.name: Gull
gull.blurb: Loud, free and unbothered. You live in the moment and take whatever the day drops near you.

turtle.name: Turtle
turtle.blurb: Patient, kind and steady. You take it slowly, you get there, and you carry home with you.

hermit.name: Hermit
hermit.blurb: Careful and homebound. You like your shell tidy and your people few, and you worry a little.

limpet.name: Limpet
limpet.blurb: You hold on tight to what you know. Orderly, direct and unbothered by waves.

urchin.name: Urchin
urchin.blurb: Neat, spiky and guarded. You keep things in order, and you keep your distance.

manatee.name: Manatee
manatee.blurb: Slow, gentle and kind. You take life as it floats by and make it softer for others.

anemone.name: Anemone
anemone.blurb: Soft, tender and sensitive. You cling to the ones you love and feel every tide.

flounder.name: Flounder
flounder.blurb: Low-key and unbothered. You blend in, keep your own counsel and let the waves go by.

stonefish.name: Stonefish
stonefish.blurb: Quiet and watchful. You stay still, you stay private, and you do not like being stepped on.

test.intro: Fifty short statements, one at a time. Answer how accurately each describes you as you are now, not as you would like to be. Your place is saved after every answer.
test.statementLabel: How accurately does this describe you?
test.retakeBody: You will answer all fifty questions again. Your last result stays saved, and the page will show it as "last time".
test.discardBody: The answers you have given in this sitting will be cleared.
test.savedHint: Saved on this device and synced with your account.

result.heading: Your portrait
result.trackAriaJournal: {{trait}}: you {{self}} out of 100, your journal {{journal}} out of 100.

openness.low: You tend to prefer the familiar and the practical.
openness.mid: You mix new ideas with what you already know.
openness.high: You are drawn to new ideas, art and experiences.

conscientiousness.low: You tend to keep plans loose and stay flexible.
conscientiousness.mid: You are organised in some places and relaxed in others.
conscientiousness.high: You like order, plans and following through.

extraversion.low: You tend to be quiet and recharge on your own.
extraversion.mid: You move between company and time to yourself.
extraversion.high: You tend to seek out people and feel energised by them.

agreeableness.low: You tend to say what you think, even when it is blunt.
agreeableness.mid: You balance being kind with standing your ground.
agreeableness.high: You tend to put people at ease and care how they feel.

neuroticism.low: You tend to stay steady when things get stressful.
neuroticism.mid: Stress affects you at times, and at times it does not.
neuroticism.high: You tend to feel stress and mood shifts strongly.

gap.close: Your journal and your answers agree on {{trait}}.
gap.journalHigher: Your journal reads as more {{adjective}} than you rated yourself.
gap.journalLower: Your journal reads as less {{adjective}} than you rated yourself.

habits.conscientiousness: You logged something on {{active}} of {{total}} days lately.
habits.openness: Lately you did {{activities}} and were in {{places}}.

result.habitsNote: The diamonds show your habits over the last {{days}} days, counted on this device. They can only speak to Openness and Conscientiousness; habits say little about the other three.

journal.heading: What your journal reads as
journal.body: Separate from the test: your own AI reads your written days and scores them on the same five traits, so you can compare.
journal.notConnected: Connect an AI in Settings to read your journal. The test works without it.
journal.noDays: No written days in the last {{days}} days. Write a few, or look back further. Only days with a title or text can be read.
journal.needTest: Take the test first, then compare it with your journal.
journal.consentTitle: Send these days to your AI?
journal.consentBody_one: The words of {{count}} written day (title, date and the first 300 characters of the entry) will be sent to {{model}}, the model named in Settings. Nothing else is sent: no birthday, no profile, no test answers.
journal.consentBody_other: The words of {{count}} written days (title, date and the first 300 characters of each entry) will be sent to {{model}}, the model named in Settings. Nothing else is sent: no birthday, no profile, no test answers.

errors.not_configured: Connect an AI in Settings first.
errors.rate_limited: You have reached today's limit of AI calls. Try again tomorrow.
errors.provider_rejected: Your AI provider turned the request down.
errors.provider_empty: Your AI provider sent back nothing.
errors.provider_unreachable: Could not reach your AI provider.
errors.provider_invalid: The AI answered in a form that could not be used. Try again.
errors.generic: Could not read your journal. Try again.

journal.window: Reads the written days from the last {{days}} days.

words.title: In your words
words.subtitle: The lines your reading leaned on
words.open_one: See {{count}} line from your own words
words.open_other: See {{count}} lines from your own words
words.empty: No lines yet. Read your journal from the You page and the lines it leans on will show up here.
words.dayChanged: From a day you have since changed

habitsRange.label: Habits and journal reading look back over
habitsRange.empty: Not enough logged days in this range for your habits to show. Try a longer one, or keep logging.

funDisclaimer: Types, codes and sea creatures are just for fun. They are a playful way to group five scores, they are not scientific, and they are not a label.
